key_insight: TurtLES benchmarks neural PDE surrogates on realistic 3D turbulent wakes, exposing temporal instability and loss of small-scale energy during autoregressive rollouts.
engineering_relevance: The benchmark tests whether CFD surrogates can sustain turbulent dynamics on large irregular meshes at industrially relevant resolution.
method: Generate 3D cylinder wakes using high-fidelity implicit large-eddy simulations.
Vary geometry, Reynolds number, and angle of attack.
Evaluate state-of-the-art neural operators through autoregressive rollouts.
evidence_signal: The 14 TB dataset contains 400 trajectories of 400 time steps each, with 3–11 million points per frame.
watch_item: The dataset's scale and irregular meshes pose substantial computational and data-handling challenges for training and evaluation.
paper_title: TurtLES: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Turbulent 3D Neural PDE Surrogates
